title: Add durable TUI runtime path configuration
purpose: Ensure TUI operations use explicit durable RunStore, AuditJournal and runtime state paths instead of transient demo state.
scope: Define CLI/config inputs for TUI run store and audit journal paths.
Default packaged paths to AgentOS runtime directories.
Reject unsafe or missing runtime paths with clear errors.
Project degraded path state in the TUI dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: TUI durable mode uses FileRunStore and AuditJournal paths from config or safe defaults.
Missing or unwritable runtime directories fail closed before any action is accepted.
Path configuration is visible in operator projection without exposing secrets.
Headless existing commands continue to work.
failure_modes: TUI silently falls back to in-memory state.
TUI writes durable state outside AgentOS runtime directories without explanation.
Path errors are hidden from operator projection.
